races.paceDynamic: Chamonix will lead uncontested from the start, with no other confirmed front runners in the field. Dark Leader, Alphonsus Liguori and Oro Blanco will track in prominent positions behind the leader, creating a moderate pace through the early stages. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Mergus Serrator, Res Ipsa and the newcomers will sit well back. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and kick clear, as the hold-up horses will need a very strong finishing effort to make up significant ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Chamonix sets a comfortable pace without early pressure
scenarios.body: The experienced prominent trio of Dark Leader, Alphonsus Liguori and Oro Blanco will be perfectly positioned to strike in the final furlong. The hold-up horses will find too much ground to make up against horses with proven form at the trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Henry Hudson or Vico Road shows superior class on debut
scenarios.body: The newcomers benefit from the steady pace and their trainers' strike rates, with Henry Hudson's breeding particularly appealing. They can sit handy and outclass this moderate maiden field with natural ability.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: Mergus Serrator gets the perfect scenario to unleash his finishing kick from the rear. The experienced hold-up horse can time his challenge perfectly in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chamonix Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Chamonix improves markedly from recent disappointing efforts
scenarios.body: The front runner gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear when the pressure comes. His stable's good form and the lack of early pace pressure creates the perfect scenario.

races.paceDynamic: What About Us is the only confirmed front runner in this small field and can dictate terms without pressure early. Glyfada and Flawless Fusion will track in behind as prominent runners, while Mo Mhuirin, Mighty Danu, and Sursum Corda prefer to sit back and come late. The lack of pace competition means What About Us can set an economical gallop before the hold-up horses make their moves in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will develop in the small field finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If What About Us gets an easy lead without early pressure
scenarios.body: She can dictate a steady pace and kick clear when the field bunches up behind her turning for home. The hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground in time with limited early pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Glyfada or Flawless Fusion press What About Us early
scenarios.body: The increased pace will set up the race for horses tracking just behind the leaders to strike late. Glyfada's recent improvement stepping up in trip makes her the most likely beneficiary.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is crawling and the field comes back to the closers
scenarios.body: Mo Mhuirin or Mighty Danu can use their finishing kicks to sweep past tiring leaders. The compact field creates traffic issues that could hinder their challenges despite the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If What About Us goes too fast early or gets headed turning in
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse getting a clear run can prevail. Sursum Corda's recent consistency despite poor finishing positions suggests ability to capitalize on such circumstances.

races.paceDynamic: Hygge and Treasure Rose will likely share early pace-setting duties, with Coul Dreamer, Teffian Warrior and Mystic Bella tracking prominently behind them. The pace should be sustainable rather than cut-throat given limited confirmed speed in this maiden field. Hold-up horses like Dazzling Angel and Tyraxes will rely on the pace collapsing, but the lack of genuine early speed suggests the race will be run at a manageable gallop. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent runners who can position handily and maintain their effort, rather than hold-up horses who need a strong pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays controlled with Hygge and Treasure Rose setting manageable fractions
scenarios.body: The handy horses maintain their position advantage as hold-up runners struggle to make ground in the straight. Treasure Rose's consistent form and Coul Dreamer's recent hurdles win give them the class edge over their rivals.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Successful
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes slightly stronger than expected with multiple prominent runners pressing
scenarios.body: This creates enough tempo for Dazzling Angel and Tyraxes to mount late challenges from their hold-up positions. The class gap narrows when pace dynamics favour closers over pure speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Hygge sets uncontested fractions and the field goes too slowly early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of position. This levels the playing field and brings outsiders like Teffian Warrior into serious contention.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the promising but lightly-raced horses like Taj Crown or Crosshaven produce significant improvement
scenarios.body: Their potential combined with tactical advantages creates upset possibilities in a relatively weak maiden. Fresh legs and unknown quantities can exploit the predictable pace scenario.

races.paceDynamic: With 18 runners and all showing hold-up styles, this race lacks any genuine early pace. Jasmine Affanalis may be forced to lead by default but will set an undemanding gallop from the front. The lack of pressure setters means the pace will be crawling through the early stages, creating a sprint finish from the 2f pole. This setup heavily favours horses with a strong finishing kick who can produce their best work in the final 200 yards when the real racing begins.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is as slow as expected with minimal pressure on the leader
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from 2f out favouring horses with the best turn of foot. Jasmine Affanalis and others with finishing speed will benefit from the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses try to improve position entering the straight simultaneously
scenarios.body: A bunching effect occurs with traffic problems developing as 18 runners converge. Those drawn low with clear runs benefit most from avoiding the scrimmaging.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Jasmine Affanalis is allowed an uncontested lead and quickens approaching 2f out
scenarios.body: The favourite gets first run on her rivals and holds on despite the slow early pace. Late challengers struggle to peg back the advantage built through superior positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wide Draw Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is so slow that wide-drawn runners can overcome their positional disadvantage
scenarios.body: Horses like Lorr's Girl and Chipsrdown use their wide berths to mount telling challenges. The inside runners get shuffled back in the sprint finish.

races.paceDynamic: Honouramongthieves will be allowed an uncontested lead with Delusional and Chicago Moon settling prominently but not pressuring early. The confirmed front runner faces no genuine pace pressure, meaning he can dictate fractions and potentially kick clear approaching the home turn. With nine of twelve runners adopting hold-up tactics, the bulk of the field will be bunched behind the leaders turning for home. This race shape strongly favors front runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early, as the hold-up horses face a significant tactical disadvantage with limited early pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Honouramongthieves sets modest fractions and kicks clear approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: The front runner exploits his tactical advantage by dictating the race tempo and having first run on his rivals. Hold-up horses struggle to make inroads from their backward positions when the pace hasn't been strong enough to set up their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is steady but quickens from halfway, suiting horses tracking the leader
scenarios.body: The prominent racers can track Honouramongthieves and challenge him when he begins to tire in the final furlong. This moderate pace scenario allows handy horses to position ideally while still compromising the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stronger than expected in the middle stages, creating a setup for closers
scenarios.body: A genuinely run race allows the hold-up horses to unleash their finishing kicks and overhaul the early leaders. Femme Beauty and Blissful Bonita benefit most from this pace dynamic with their proven ability to stay this trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If tactical positioning creates a bunched field turning for home with multiple challengers
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge from the home turn with positioning and jockey skill determining the outcome. Multiple horses from different parts of the field converge in a messy finish that could suit an improver.

races.paceDynamic: Slurricane and Winning Smut will likely contest the early lead with Wandering Rocks, Sequoiaspirit, and Hidalgo Des Mottes tracking in prominent positions. The pace should be honest but not excessive given the 2m1f distance and soft ground conditions. Harry's Legacy, Factual Fact, Dark Note, Riyami, and Chain Of Destiny will settle further back looking to finish strongly. This moderate early gallop over the extended trip will favour hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishing kicks, as the pace-setters will be vulnerable to challengers with superior finishing speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves steady and the leaders tire from 2f out
scenarios.body: The soft ground and extended distance will sap the prominent runners, allowing the hold-up brigade to sweep past with superior finishing speed. Harry's Legacy and Factual Fact have the class and tactical advantage to capitalize on this unfolding.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Raider Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Wandering Rocks can improve on his recent Dundalk third and travel strongly throughout
scenarios.body: His new blinkers and recent form uptick could see him dominate from a handy position, with Slurricane providing the main threat from similar tactics. The moderate early pace would suit both horses' prominent running styles.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Slurricane and Winning Smut go faster than expected early and maintain their advantage
scenarios.body: The faster pace would stretch the field and prevent the hold-up horses from closing effectively down the home straight. Slurricane's recent Gowran form gives him the edge over his fellow pace-setter.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Factual Fact Class Tells
scenarios.trigger: If the De Bromhead runner can overcome his hold-up style disadvantage through superior ability
scenarios.body: His Curragh second suggests untapped potential, and the yard's 13% strike rate could see him time his challenge perfectly despite the tactical setup. The soft ground conditions would play to his strengths from his bumper-winning days.

races.paceDynamic: Ebony King will lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners to pressure him, meaning Andrew Slattery can dictate a comfortable tempo through the early stages. The prominent runners Tim Toe and Stellar Quality will track just behind, while the hold-up brigade of Farren Glory, Sky Captain, Defiantly and Kizlyar will settle towards the rear. With one uncontested leader setting his own fractions over this stamina-testing 1m6f trip, the pace will be sustainable rather than searching. This controlled gallop strongly favours the hold-up horses who can unleash late kicks, as they'll have plenty left in the tank when the real racing begins.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Ebony King gets easy fractions and maintains his kick
scenarios.body: The lone leader gets first run and holds on as the closers leave their challenge too late over this stamina-sapping trip. His recent Grade 2 form gives him the class edge when not having to fight for the lead.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the sustainable pace allows the back-markers to wind up
scenarios.body: Sky Captain or Defiantly time their run perfectly as Ebony King's sustained gallop leaves him vulnerable to a strong closer. The patient tactics pay dividends with a decisive late surge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Tim Toe and Stellar Quality get the jump on the field
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners get first run on the leader while the hold-up horses are still getting organized. Their tactical position proves crucial as they can respond immediately to any move from Ebony King.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Farren Glory Class
scenarios.trigger: If the ex-Grade 1 winner rediscovers his best form
scenarios.body: Despite his recent struggles, Farren Glory's superior class rating tells as he produces a trademark late flourish. His hold-up style is perfectly suited to capitalize on the steady early gallop.
